items.title: Define the frozen Finding and Verdict schemas in packages/main/src/core/adversarial-review.ts exactly per spec §2.2/§2.3
items.context: New module core/adversarial-review.ts. Finding = {severity: 'BLOCKER'|'MAJOR'|'MINOR', title: string, file: string, line: number, issue: string, fix: string}. Verdict = {isReal: boolean, agreedSeverity: 'BLOCKER'|'MAJOR'|'MINOR'|'NOT_A_DEFECT', reasoning: string}. Use exported types + the severity union as a const tuple/type so it matches §2.2/§2.3 verbatim. Note: these are the ABSTRACT methodology severities (BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR) — the finding_add ledger mapping (critical|high|medium|low) is S2's concern, not S0's.

happy.desc: the smoke constructs a valid Finding {severity,title,file,line,issue,fix} and Verdict {isReal,agreedSeverity,reasoning} and asserts every field is present + typed; WHY: the frozen schemas are the contract S1-S4 import

edge.desc: the smoke asserts the severity unions are EXACTLY {BLOCKER,MAJOR,MINOR} (Finding) and {BLOCKER,MAJOR,MINOR,NOT_A_DEFECT} (Verdict.agreedSeverity) — no extra/missing member; WHY: a wrong union breaks the abstract->ledger mapping in S2

adversarial.desc: tsc build is clean (the types compile) and lattice validate stays green; WHY: a non-compiling contract blocks every later story

items.title: Define the canonical lens set (+ task-tunable flag) and the completeness-critic IO contract per §2.1/§2.4
items.context: Export the canonical lens set: concept/scope, code-quality, behavior/correctness, test-coverage, crash-safety/edge, docs-consistency (as a typed list of {id, facet, asks} or at least the id union), with a documented 'task-tunable' note (the set may be subset/extended per change). Export the CompletenessCritic IO contract type: input {change, confirmedFindings: Finding[]}, output Finding[] (its findings re-enter verification — that is S2/S3's concern; S0 only types the IO).

happy.desc: the smoke asserts CANONICAL_LENS_SET has EXACTLY the 6 spec entries with ids concept-scope, code-quality, behavior-correctness, test-coverage, crash-safety-edge, docs-consistency; WHY: S1 iterates this set

edge.desc: the lens set is documented task-tunable (a note/flag) and the CompletenessCritic IO type is exported (input change+confirmedFindings:Finding[], output Finding[]); WHY: S1 may subset the set; S3 imports the critic IO

adversarial.desc: no behavior leaks into the lens-set/critic-IO definitions (data + types only, no functions that run lenses or the critic); WHY: behavior is S1/S3

items.title: Define the review-mode interface encoding the canonical round order (§2.4/§3.2/§4.2)
items.context: Export an interface/types for the review MODE round: the canonical order is run lenses -> adversarially verify lens raw findings -> run critic on {change, CONFIRMED lens findings} -> verify critic raw findings -> converge-or-reopen. Encode the order as a declared constant (e.g. an ordered phase enum/tuple REVIEW_MODE_PHASES) AND a round/result interface (lenses, confirmedFindings, criticFindings, reopen: boolean, converged: boolean) so S1-S4 wire to a single declared surface and cannot drift from the spec. Types + interface only — NO behavior/implementation.

happy.desc: the smoke asserts REVIEW_MODE_PHASES equals the canonical 5-step order [lenses, verify-lens-findings, critic, verify-critic-findings, converge-or-reopen]; WHY: the single declared source of truth for the round order

edge.desc: a Round/RoundResult interface is exported with fields covering lenses, confirmedFindings, criticFindings, reopen:boolean, converged:boolean; WHY: S4 wires the round/reopen loop to this surface

adversarial.desc: the interface/const carry NO implementation (types + a const data tuple only); WHY: types-only contract

items.title: Hermetic smoke proving the contract compiles + matches the spec; register in lattice.config.json
items.context: New packages/main/src/tasks/adversarial-review-contract-smoke.ts: construct a valid Finding and a valid Verdict (assert shape/fields), assert the canonical lens set has exactly the 6 spec entries with the right ids, assert REVIEW_MODE_PHASES is the canonical 5-step order, and assert the severity unions are exactly {BLOCKER,MAJOR,MINOR} / {...,NOT_A_DEFECT}. tsc compiling is itself part of the proof. Register the smoke in lattice.config.json validate.commands.

happy.desc: node packages/main/dist/tasks/adversarial-review-contract-smoke.js prints its pass line (exit 0) and is registered in lattice.config.json validate.commands; WHY: the contract is CI-checked

edge.desc: the smoke is hermetic (no FS/git/store), pure type+const assertions; WHY: a contract smoke needs no environment

adversarial.desc: lattice validate runs all configured commands green including the new smoke; WHY: no regression
